description: Read-only RSI, EMA, SMA, MACD, Bollinger bands and ATR over closed candles. Supply candles or symbol/venue (Hyperliquid). Returns latest values, effective params, candle window, source, as-of time and stale label. Prices are used as supplied; gaps and insufficient history are explicit errors. Periods 1-500; max 16 indicators, 1000 supplied candles and a venue count of 5000. Defaults: RSI/ATR 14, EMA/SMA/Bollinger 20, MACD 12/26/9, Bollinger stdDev 2. Freshness is measured from the last candle close; stale after one interval. Optional analysis adds confirmed break of structure, change of character, order blocks, fair value gaps, squeeze and named timeframe alignment with evidence. Analysis caps venue count at 1000 and total supplied candles at 1000; public mainnet only for analysis venue reads. Historical behavior, not trading advice.

analysis.description: Request at least one true flag or one to two additional intervals. Fixed ta-structure-v1 definitions; no source mixing. Every extra frame needs candles when primary candles are supplied, and none may supply candles otherwise.

candles.description: Chronological, consecutive closed OHLCV candles. t is opening Unix time in milliseconds. Empty/short arrays return INSUFFICIENT_CANDLES.
Chronological, consecutive closed OHLCV candles. t is opening Unix time in milliseconds. Empty/short arrays return INSUFFICIENT_CANDLES.

count.description: Venue candle count; defaults to max(200, required warmup). Omit with explicit candles.

symbol.description: Hyperliquid market identifier, e.g. ETH or xyz:XYZ. Required without candles.

venue.description: Required without candles. With candles, symbol/venue are caller-provided labels; source remains caller.
